integrity: The polynomial generator identity, complete-square identity, and both equilibrium substitutions were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. The generalized Case P equations and the multistability motivation were inspected in the same-author parameter study; the original publication date and scope were verified from the publisher record. Claims about unavailable prior papers are restricted to accessible abstract or metadata content.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove existence of non-equilibrium compact recurrence for every parameter pair.
The support conclusion is qualitative and does not bound the occupation fractions on the two sides of the equilibrium slab.
Complete full texts of several plausible prior analytical/statistical studies were unavailable; accessible abstracts were compared and the unresolved coverage risk is retained.
The theorem does not classify periodic or chaotic invariant measures separately.
title: Exact stationary mean–variance parabola and equilibrium-slab occupation in Sprott P
